name: eclipseal
description: Eclipseal: confidential AI compute (agents, private LLMs, GPU jobs in TEEs) on Robinhood Chain.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/web run build
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix apps/api run start" "npm --prefix apps/web run start"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && cd apps/web && npx tsc --noEmit
scripts.brand:render: npm --prefix brand/render install && npm --prefix brand/render run render
scripts.brand:campaign: npm --prefix brand/render install && npm --prefix brand/render run render:campaign
